# Beverly's of Nashville

> Official hair-care website for Teddy Chisom, a Nashville hairstylist known as The Hair Care King.

## About

Teddy Chisom is a Nashville hairstylist, master colorist, and custom wig artist. He is not affiliated with the separate barbershop business. Beverly's of Nashville focuses only on Teddy's hair-care work.

## Services

- Hair color, including dimensional color, highlights, gray coverage, glossing, and corrective consultation
- Silk presses, healthy-hair styling, trims, and occasion finishes
- Extensions and maintenance
- Custom fashion and hair-loss wigs, including consultation, fit, color, installation, and maintenance
- The Reveal Session: hair styling, professional makeup, in-salon portraits, and ten edited digital photographs
